description: Noise generator with a white, pink or brown output and a second output blending white noise with a filtered version of it

params.text: Sets the cutoff of the low-pass filter in the coloured noise path, 10kHz to 50kHz.
Sets the cutoff of the high-pass filter in the coloured noise path, 500Hz to 2.5kHz.
Crossfades the COLORED NOISE output from plain white noise to the filtered noise.
Picks white, pink or brown noise for the NOISE output.

inputs.text: Scales the amplitude of both outputs, silent at 0V and full at 10V; with nothing patched here both outputs stay at full level.

outputs.text: White, pink or brown noise, whichever TYPE selects.
White noise and the filtered noise blended by the MIX knob.

inputs.0:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
